author: compatibility_audit

scopes.queryScope: Only the existing empty-query save/restore forms enter the new stream profile. Existing inspect/cancel pending restore, snapshot-repair, lossless-export and native-large remain on their existing explicit paths.
scopes.forceSemantics: Preserve existing same-seal/native restore rules and cross-seal rejection. No new force acceptance; B05 continues with no force flag.

sourceFindings.claim: Standby native snapshot currently returns an audited trusted-origin 307 before actor admission or body staging.
Official v2.7.1 httpRequestWithContext performs a second Do but returns the first Response; ResetJSONBody does not rewind a body without BodyBytes.
Existing ordinary forward completion response digest covers JSON Response and headers, not external file bytes.
AuthenticatedPeerFrame and its callback currently require a bounded complete Vec request/response, so they cannot stream an archive by changing only a route.
Snapshot source and historical restore have distinct owner/final audit rules; restore uses the retained original Auth and newly committed epoch.
Current H2 snapshot ingress collects a body up to 32 MiB before the native logical pipeline; this proposal does not remove that existing bound.
No-forward preference is an original-ingress-bound routing preference; any first nonempty header value including false or 0 disables forwarding.

decisions.decision: Extend only default native snapshot standby handling with a typed affine forwarding plan; direct leader execution retains the current native plan and finalization.
Use the configured cluster peer endpoint and enrolled peer identity. Do not proxy arbitrary API origins or trust client/SDK Location/Host as a peer endpoint.
One peer connection, one logical admission, one transfer, one final response. Leader change or unsupported peer profile never causes a second target/attempt or redirect fallback.
Explicit source/target/cluster/hop binding and exact selected server certificate pin are verified before forwarding token, certificate metadata or archive bytes.
Receiver independently admits original token/namespace/policy once; standby performs no second finite-use persistence. A valid peer is not the end-user Actor.
Add an authenticated bounded stream branch to the peer transport. Keep the old full-frame branch and limits byte-for-byte equivalent where untouched.
Use a dedicated binary completion descriptor and snapshot completion variants. Never append a file to an otherwise valid ordinary JSON receipt.

Hold downloaded bytes in a private unlinked SnapshotFile until full peer termination, descriptor/hash proof, local owner/catch-up and terminal audit gates have succeeded. Do not emit a success HTTP head early.
Preserve explicit original-ingress no-forward preference as trusted 307. Preserve unsupported/nonempty-query paths on their existing explicit behavior.

transport.direction: one enrolled standby -> one configured elected leader, response returns over the same authenticated connection
transport.negotiation: An explicit native snapshot stream profile. Unknown/version mismatch is a terminal rejection; no fallback or retransmission.
authenticationBeforeSecrets: CA chain and configured peer server name
selected target enrolled server leaf pin under existing accepted rotation policy
receiver maps actual authenticated client leaf to source NodeId
cluster/direction/source/target/hop=1 all match actual authenticated and local identities
prelude: version/profile, fresh nonce, cluster, source and target
method, exact canonical route and admitted query data
original namespace/token/wrap TTL/origin/certificate/logical metadata using existing per-field validation
declared upload length when the original HTTP framing makes it available; absence does not remove the archive cap
relative remaining allowance clamped to receiver original accept-origin deadline; no cross-host Instant serialization
transport.requestBinding: Domain-separated canonical prelude digest plus final verified upload count/digest (zero for download). A nonce permits prelude admission, but final completion cannot be minted until the exact body END is verified.
transport.hashPurpose: Integrity and exact response/request binding inside mutually authenticated custody; a hash alone grants no Actor, storage or retry authority.
uploadFlow: leader native actor admission exactly once
single original body reader -> bounded peer chunks
receiver END/count/SHA verified before native import can see EOF
original native restore finalization and audit
dedicated completed response or preserved reconciliation outcome
downloadFlow: leader native actor admission exactly once
original native snapshot generation into held SnapshotFile
original native source/final audit gate plus bound descriptor
local authenticated catch-up and final delivery audit
original HTTP writer receives the held file
transport.emptyBodyAndHead: HEAD binds the same status/representation descriptor without transmitting body bytes; illegal request bodies and upload/response direction mismatches are rejected.
transport.earlyRejection: A peer can reject before accepting upload; the ingress never starts a second upload or drains an unbounded rejected body. Existing HTTP close/error handling remains bounded.
transport.noEffectInference: After original metadata is sent, transport failure may include Actor/token-use persistence or restore effects; absent an authenticated completed outcome never means no effect.

variants.download: Only existing complete_native_ha_snapshot_delivery success may mint DownloadCompleted. Bind exported root/generation separately from the allowed observation-only terminal successor, plus exact archive descriptor.
variants.restore: Only existing complete_native_ha_historical_delivery success may mint HistoricalRestoreCompleted. Bind original admission identity and Actor witness/authorization provenance, operation digest, committed restored root/epoch and actual terminal successor. This proof authorizes only delivery of this completed response, never re-upload, re-publish, a new current read, or a new Actor.
variants.rejection: Bounded authenticated terminal rejection must retain exact native error semantics. A rejection receipt does not certify successful transfer or no previous admission effect.
variants.uncertain: Retain native recovery_reference/root_attempted/retry_allowed=false where produced; missing final proof or delivery veto cannot become success.

completion.nativePlanLifetime: Do not drop or consume the original SnapshotTransferPlan/NativeHaReadProof/NativeHaHistoricalReceipt before completion fields are minted after existing owner/audit/clock checks.
completion.currentActorCaution: Historical restore intentionally checks retained original Auth and an actual new activation/epoch. Do not mechanically substitute current-restored-Auth ordinary forwarding checks or compare a rotated legitimate owner to the pre-restore owner.
completion.ingressDelivery: Verify current HA Arc, authenticated committed prefix and publication MAC, then catch up under the original deadline and actual local seal/barrier owner. Capture the new local delivery capsule only after verified installation. Preserve pre-audit and post-audit veto checks; discard held response on failure.
completion.localTransitionProof: A historical restore receipt must prove the specific old-to-new publication from the leader's existing typed receipt. Local catch-up does not re-run restore or consume the token again; unrelated owner changes continue to veto.
completion.noWeakening: No boolean OR accepting either legacy/current Actor; no unsigned archive descriptor; no unauthenticated response used as completion; no reuse of old generic completion constructor for a file.

ownership.receiverWorkers: Use existing actual peer OS-thread worker and forwarding-slot capacity, retain the permit through final transfer/flush/drop. Do not consume reserved ReadIndex/root-pull/native slots or spawn an unowned thread.
ownership.ingressWorkers: Keep existing H1 worker/H2 outer spawn_blocking + scoped plain worker and original deadline. No join on the reactor and no detached archive task.
ownership.spool: Reuse SnapshotSpool/SnapshotLease and immediately unlinked descriptor-backed SnapshotFile. Existing single busy lease is per Service, not a global 16/32 claim. Bind any new standby spool ownership to the affine forwarding plan.
ownership.cancellation: Peer close, reset, cancellation, panic or deadline drops the unique transport/file/lease and retains uncertain-effect classification after admission. Slot release waits for actual worker termination, not only awaiter cancellation.
ownership.emittedBytes: Gate before first success response byte; already emitted bytes cannot be recalled. Subsequent write/close failure does not grant retry or reclassify remote effects.

limits.archiveLimitExpression: MAX_NATIVE_ARCHIVE = MAX_SNAPSHOT_ENTRY + 1024*1024; use original feature-dependent typed constant, no larger limit
limits.memory: O(65536 + existing bounded metadata + fixed TLS buffer), no archive-sized Vec/base64
limits.disk: At most one additional archive-sized held spool at the standby for a download, subject to the existing per-Service lease and actual configured concurrency
limits.time: Ingress original absolute request deadline clipped by existing configured forward_timeout; receiver deadline begins at actual TCP admission and clips again to smaller received remaining allowance. Every read/write/hash/spool/catch-up/audit uses the same decreasing deadline.

proposedCodeSeams.change: Add typed standby Forward admission for the allowlist; preserve direct Execute, explicit Redirect, native plan and error semantics.
Dispatch the new affine Forward plan using the original body reader/deadline; hand only finalized Json/File back to existing writers.
Capture configured endpoint and exact pin under short control custody; register a dedicated snapshot stream handler and retain existing forwarding permits; no leader chase.

proposedCodeSeams.path: crates/heptabao-ha-service/src/authenticated_peer_frame.rs and a new bounded snapshot stream module
proposedCodeSeams.change: Add explicit authenticated stream branch/capability without exposing an unauthenticated raw stream or altering old frame profiles.
Share unchanged publication primitives only where their byte semantics remain valid; add distinct binary descriptor/domain/variants rather than widening ordinary response_digest.
Reuse the existing authenticated-prefix/catch-up/fence model with separate historical-restore semantics, never manufacture a replacement original Actor.
Register the weak Service snapshot handler; preserve HTTP parsing and H2 worker setup.

necessaryComponents: Wrong pin/ALPN/source/target/cluster/hop rejects before protected bytes or native admission; exact valid peer is accepted.
Original finite-use Actor admitted once; namespace/policy rejection and original no-forward preference retain behavior.
Default save and upload cross the old 1 MiB ordinary-frame size using fixed chunks, exact END/count/hash and no whole-archive Vec.
Truncated body, mismatched final digest/count, extra frame, expired original deadline and transport cancellation never publish a successful completion or leak custody.
Download or historical restore final owner/clock/audit veto prevents a success delivery; a committed-but-undelivered restore retains reconciliation and retry prohibition.
Historical restore with legitimate epoch/Auth replacement exercises its original-Actor completion variant; old generic current-Actor shortcut is not accepted.
Leader changes before admission or during original finalization cause one terminal attempt; no implicit redirect/retry.
Original H1 and H2 current input-boundary behavior remains; no assertion of larger H2 streaming support.
futureValidation.fixtureDelta: Version only the audit topology classifier to distinguish exact ingress+leader forwarded terminal pairs from a single direct pair and the old 307 pattern. Keep all CLI invocations, no manual redirect/retry, B04 exit0+valid archive+known200 and B05 exit0+known200/204+exact all-node baseline plus original cold-restart checks.
futureValidation.actualQualificationRequired: New reviewed source, fresh normal candidate/binaries and exact authorized fresh PhaseB B01-B05; independent H2 and larger archive evidence remain separate. Existing 4e results are not transferred to a successor.

unresolvedImplementationProofs: Concrete API for stream dispatch must not expose the TLS socket outside authenticated private ownership or bypass reserved worker capacity.
Exact terminal binary publication format and the historical-restore original-Actor/epoch variant require source review before code.
The follower's allowed owner transition during authenticated historical catch-up must be tied to the exact published operation, not an arbitrary current owner replacement.
The new fixture audit association needs explicit versioned topology and, if introduced, a closed nonsecret forward correlation field. It must not invent a request identity from adjacent logs.
